entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Albin Małysiak C.M. was a Polish bishop of the Roman Catholic Church. At the time of his death, he was one of the oldest Catholic bishops and the oldest Polish bishop. He was also a Righteous Among the Nations, having sheltered several Jews during the war.
